Dialogs.Text: Two separate kobold groups occupy Cave A: four guards in the northern entrance chamber and four in the eastern store room. Clear both groups, in either order, then return for 20 gold and 50 XP. Leave through the south gate and follow the Borderlands trail northeast to the ravine.
You cleared the entrance guards, but the store-room guards remain in the eastern chamber of Cave A. Finish that group before I can pay you. Your progress is recorded.

Choices.Text: I will return to the eastern store room.

Dialogs.Text: You cleared the store-room guards, but the entrance guards remain in the northern chamber of Cave A. Finish that group before I can pay you. Your progress is recorded.

Choices.Text: I will return to the northern chamber.

Dialogs.Text: Both kobold groups are cleared! Report your success to collect the promised reward.
Both kobold groups still need clearing. From the south gate, follow the trail northeast to the ravine, then enter Cave A on its northern ledge.
You cleared both kobold groups and have already received your reward. The Keep is safer thanks to you.
Four kobolds block the chamber. They clutch their weapons and refuse to move.
Four kobolds guard supplies in the eastern store room. They raise their weapons as you approach.
